description: Adds CV control to up to 32 parameters of any modules, taking the voltages from two polyphonic inputs.

inputs.text: The sixteen channels feeding mapping slots 1 to 16; 0-10V, or -5V to 5V on the menu.
The sixteen channels feeding mapping slots 17 to 32; 0-10V, or -5V to 5V on the menu.

notes: nothing is controlled until a slot is mapped: click a slot in the list, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module; mapping then moves to the next empty slot.
a mapped parameter's own right-click menu gains a CV-MAP Menu item, for changing which input channel drives it and for reaching this module's settings from there.
menu: Slew-limiting, Low and High — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu: Slew-limiting smooths the incoming voltage, and Low and High scale the range it drives, Low above High inverting it.
Lock parameter changes — switched off, a mapped parameter can be moved by hand for as long as its input voltage stays where it is.
Input channel — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu, picks which of the 32 input channels drives that slot.
Audio rate processing — switched off, mapped parameters are updated every 32nd sample instead of every sample.
Channel 1 to Channel 16 — on an input port's own right-click menu, give that channel a text label, which the Input channel list on each mapping slot then shows.
Signal input — reads the two input ports as 0V..10V or as -5V..5V.
Map module (left) — binds the parameters of the module on the left to the mapping slots in order, and Map module (select) does the same for a module you then click.
Clear all mappings — empties every mapping slot.
User interface — holds Text scrolling, Lock mapping slots, and the mapping indicator settings Hide, a colour picker and Reset color.
Unmap and Locate and indicate — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu, releasing that slot's parameter, or centring its module on screen and flashing its indicator.
